title: FBI Photo B004
sensor_system_note: B-series — large full-frame crosshair reticle, '12/31/99 HH:MM:SS' factory-reset sensor clock visible bottom-left, scale markings '15 10 5 | 5 10 15' in burst-1 / early burst-2 and '3' after the high-mag zoom at B022. Sky/atmosphere background throughout (no terrain in burst 2). Different sensor system from A-series.

pages.description: A grainy grayscale image resembling a targeting or surveillance display with a centered white crosshair reticle. The horizontal axis of the reticle is marked with numeric graduations reading 15, 10, 5 to the left of center and 5, 10, 15 to the right of center, with small tick marks along both axes. A large solid black rectangular bar spans the top of the frame. Several smaller black rectangular bars (resembling redaction or overlay blocks) are positioned symmetrically on the left and right sides at three vertical levels. The background is a mottled gray with visible noise. A white timestamp reading '12/31/99 18:12:16' appears in the lower-left corner.

observations.claim: A white crosshair reticle is centered in the image

The image has visible grain/noise throughout the gray background
